scope: Same-input all-layer search-scope diagnostic. Detours are complete saved-route net records with same-layer terminals and at least one actual inter-layer edge, deduplicated within net. Failed traces are descriptive only. Native FULL and independent audit plus input seal required for legal CPD comparison. Cross-resource accounting comes from independent audit, not raw edge counts.
